Remove all unused imports in pkg/proxy/proxy.go and pkg/dashboard/server.go.
Fix the compilation error regarding the redeclaration of DefaultMaxBodyCaptureBytes.

system_impact: The PR causes a total system failure. The proxy server will fail to start, and the dashboard is disconnected from the proxy engine. This is a critical regression that must be reverted immediately.
